Title: Senior Data Scientist (Hybrid Guadalajara)
Description: Insulet started in 2000 with an idea and a mission to enable our customers to enjoy simplicity, freedom and healthier lives through the use of our Omnipod® product platform. In the last two decades we have improved the lives of hundreds of thousands of patients by using innovative technology that is wearable, waterproof, and lifestyle accommodating. We are looking for highly motivated, performance driven individuals to be a part of our expanding team. We do this by hiring amazing people guided by shared values who exceed customer expectations. Our continued success depends on it! Position Overview Insulet Corporation, maker of the OmniPod, is the leader in tubeless insulin pump. The Senior Data Scientist role is responsible for research and development of Insulet’s brand new and strategic insulin therapy optimization solution for patients and healthcare providers. You will be developing analytics to gain insights of device settings, usage patterns, failure modes, and clinical outcomes. Using machine learning and pattern recognition techniques, you will develop algorithms to recommend optimal pump parameters to achieve the best clinical outcome. As one of the first team members, you have the opportunity to shape the technical framework and grow your role within the company tremendously. Responsibilities Work with IT and cross functional teams to identify data sources, design data ingestion and data storage platforms. Develop data clean up and preprocessing scripts as needed. Explore data patterns using existing data science tools and self-created programs. Develop and implement algorithms for insulin pump therapy optimization. Present findings to leadership and non-specialists in relation to business objectives. Mentor junior engineers. Performs other duties as required. Education And Experience Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a closely related field preferred. At least 5 years of work and research experience on machine learning, artificial intelligence, or statistical inferences. Experiences in medical device or healthcare industries is desirable. Preferred Skills And Competencies Demonstrated proficiency in one or more analytic software tools, such as Python, R, Matlab, etc. Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and one or more relational databases, such as Oracle, Teradata, Microsoft SQL Server, etc. Experience in C/C++, C#, Java programming is a plus. Experience in Business Intelligence tools, such as Tableau, Spotfire, Cognos, is a plus. Demonstrated knowledge of software engineering principles and practices. Ability to work independently without detailed guidance yet maintaining effective communications with leaders and stakeholders. NOTE : This position is eligible for hybrid working arrangements and requires on-site work from an Insulet office at least three (3) days per week.

Title: Junior Reporting Analyst
Description: Position Summary The Junior Reporting Analyst supports several departments by preparing, maintaining, validating, and distributing recurring operational reports. The position also assists with ad-hoc reporting requests, data entry, data extraction, report testing, and documentation. This is an entry-level position intended for someone who has strong Microsoft Excel skills, careful attention to detail, and an interest in developing a career in reporting and data analytics. Training will be provided on departmental processes, HubSpot, SAP, Amazon Connect, and internal reporting systems. The analyst will work under the direction of the department manager and collaborate with operational team members to ensure reports are accurate, complete, understandable, and delivered on schedule. Essential Functions Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Prepare, validate, and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports. Maintain existing Microsoft Excel reports, templates, formulas, data connections, and supporting documentation. Use Excel functions such as XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, filters, and conditional formatting to organize and analyze data. Combine, compare, and reconcile information from multiple worksheets, workbooks, and reporting systems. Review reports for missing information, duplicate records, inconsistent values, formula errors, and other potential data-quality issues. Follow established report-validation procedures and maintain a consistently high level of accuracy. Assist with extracting data from HubSpot, SAP, Amazon Connect, internal applications, and other approved reporting systems. Support ad-hoc reporting and data requests under the direction of the department manager or senior team members. Document report procedures, business rules, data sources, validation steps, and recurring reporting schedules. Communicate reporting issues, delays, or unclear requirements to management in a timely manner. Assist with testing report changes and confirming that updated reports produce the intended results. Recommend practical improvements to recurring reports after becoming familiar with the reporting process and departmental needs. Organize and prioritize multiple recurring assignments to meet established deadlines. Present straightforward findings to department management with guidance when appropriate. Protect confidential business, customer, and employee information in accordance with company policies. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Title: AI Systems & Agent Engineer (Python / AWS)
Description: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Software Engineer to join an exciting AI product that's already in production and actively being deployed to clients. This is a project-based role for one month, with the possibility of extension based on project needs. Rather than building a new application from scratch, you'll work on improving and strengthening an existing AI platform. You'll review the current codebase, improve the architecture where needed, help make the AI system more reliable, and support deployments across different client environments. You'll work closely with the product owner to understand the existing solution, implement improvements, and help build a scalable foundation for future growth. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex systems before making changes. The ideal candidate is comfortable working within an existing Python codebase, identifying opportunities for improvement, and making thoughtful changes without introducing regressions. You have experience building or working with AI-powered applications and understand how to improve AI behavior through structured testing, evaluation, and iteration. You enjoy solving technical problems, take ownership of engineering quality, and like working on products powered by modern AI technologies. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Review and understand an existing Python codebase and AI platform. Improve software architecture, code quality, and maintainability. Enhance AI agent behavior through prompt engineering, evaluation, context management, and testing. Safely refactor existing functionality while maintaining system stability. Troubleshoot complex issues across the application and deployment environment. Build and improve automated tests to prevent regressions. Develop and maintain backend APIs and integrations. Support deployments across different client environments. Document technical decisions and engineering processes. Collaborate closely with the product owner throughout the project. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 4–5 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, or similar role. Professional working proficiency in English. Strong professional experience with Python. Experience working with existing production codebases and refactoring software safely. Experience building or contributing to AI-powered applications, LLM workflows, AI agents, RAG systems, or similar technologies. Solid understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices. Experience with REST APIs and backend integrations. Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or similar AI frameworks. Experience evaluating and improving LLM performance. Experience writing automated tests and regression tests. Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with Linux environments. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval-based systems. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive compensation. Project-based contract under Mexican Federal Labor Law (1 month with possibility of extension). Remote work environment based in Guadalajara. Opportunity to work on an innovative AI product using cutting-edge technologies. Collaborative team with potential for future long-term opportunities. If this sounds like a role where you'll thrive, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Associate Software Engineer
Description: Job Description Engineering Guadalajara, hybrid 6 Months Fixed Term, Transitioning to Permanent Learn to build with AI. Own what ships. Grow into a great engineer. This is the start of your career, and we want it to count. If you’re early in your software engineering journey and you want to get good fast, working in an experienced team that builds with AI, SPAN is for you. It's also your entry point into SPAN LEAP (Learn, Engineer, Apply, Progress) our structured development program built to turn early-career engineers into well-rounded, AI-ready engineers. You'll not only write code but learn to think like an engineer, breaking problems down, directing AI toward clear, testable goals, and knowing when a solution, yours or the AI's, is right. You'll ship real, live work from day one, backed by a team who've done this before, building the judgment and habits that separate the engineers who thrive from the ones who plateau. We're looking for people who think critically, stay curious, and adapt fast when things change. About SPAN LEAP This role sits inside SPAN LEAP, our 12-month track that develops early-career engineers into AI-ready software engineers through real work rather than classroom training. The program runs in two stages: Stage 1: the first 6 months are a fixed-term training and evaluation period, during which we assess fit and progress against the program’s plan. Stage 2: Engineers who are meeting expectations may then continue the remaining 6 months of LEAP with the same mentorship and structured growth, but as permanent SPAN employees - a status that continues beyond the program's completion. As a SPAN LEAP Participant, You Can Expect A structured path across core engineering skill areas: front-end, APIs, data, DevOps, testing, documentation, with AI readiness built in from day one, not bolted on afterward. A real mentorship model: a working SPAN engineer is paired with you and spends dedicated time every week guiding you on live projects, alongside pair programming and structured, group-based learning loops with the rest of your cohort. Hands-on AI engineering practice: learning to direct and orchestrate AI tools toward well-defined, testable goals, not just use them as a shortcut. What You'll Do As an associate engineer, you'll work as part of a delivery team, taking on small, well-defined pieces of work with support from senior engineers. Day to day, you'll: Write, review, reason about, and validate code for small, clearly defined features, making sure it meets our coding standards and practices. Use AI tools and help orchestrate AI agents toward well-defined, testable goals. Investigate and fix bugs with guidance from more experienced engineers. Write and run tests, and make sure coverage handles both the basic cases and the edge cases. Take part in code reviews as both an author and a reviewer, and act on the feedback you get. Help configure and maintain the automated quality gates that keep our code healthy, and understand why those standards exist. Own the quality of your output, regardless of how it was produced. What We're Looking For You don't need years of experience. You do need a real foundation, strong critical thinking, and the drive to build on both. We're looking for someone who: Has 6-12 months experience. Can read and write code in at least one programming language (Java, Python, or Golang, TypeScript preferred), and understands core software development concepts. Breaks problems down clearly and can reason about whether a solution really is correct. Is keen to work with AI coding tools, and understands that the engineer owns the result, not the tool. Is comfortable with version control, or eager to learn Git properly. Learns quickly, asks substantive questions, and treats feedback as a way to get better. Communicates clearly and works well as part of a team. Nice to have None of these are required. Any of them will help you stand out: Hands-on experience with AI development tools, such as AI coding assistants or agent-based workflows. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or personal projects we can look at. Exposure to testing, a web or mobile framework, or a cloud platform. Internship, freelance, or open-source experience. How You'll Grow Growth is built into how we work, not left to chance. As a LEAP participant, you'll follow a personal growth plan over the 12-month program with clear goals, paired with a dedicated mentor. You'll learn through pair programming with senior engineers, AI-assisted learning loops, code review, and career coaching, and we'll measure your progress against SFIA, the globally recognized skills framework we use across the company. The expectation is simple: take more on, with less supervision, as your skills and judgment develop. Performance during the first 6 months determines whether you continue in the program as a permanent SPAN employee for the remaining 6 months, with growth and SFIA-based progression continuing through the full 12-month arc - after which you remain a permanent SPAN employee with LEAP complete. About SPAN SPAN Digital is a software product and consulting company headquartered in San Francisco, with development offices in Cape Town and Guadalajara. We work across a range of industries, with particular depth in technology, digital media, and fintech. For more than 13 years we've strategized, designed, and built software for clients ranging from startups to global brands. Our Services teams work side by side with clients to design prototypes, launch production-ready services, and lead major product enhancements. Senior people take real accountability for outcomes, document what they build, and hand it off well. We're often called in for the complex work internal teams can't get to: fragile, business-critical systems; modernization that can't disrupt operations; and AI initiatives that need to move past the proof-of-concept stage. Our Product teams draw on that same vantage point to build software that helps enterprises capture and use their own knowledge and gives engineering leaders real-time visibility into the systems they run, so they can make faster, more consistent decisions. We're a global, high-performing team building smart solutions for ambitious clients. At SPAN, you'll work alongside experienced founders, tackle meaningful challenges, and keep growing personally and professionally. We balance structure with flexibility, autonomy with accountability, and learning with doing. It's not about grinding, it's about thriving. What We Offer Flexible and generous work & leave schedule Hybrid working model (the best of both worlds) Learning organization based on a reverence for expertise & craftsmanship (TechRadar Sessions, complimentary education, journals, e-Learning) Team lunches, collaboration sessions, and events Charitable community initiatives, employee awards, and recognition MacBook Pro You will love it here if You are allergic to hierarchical, bureaucratic cultures You want to work with very smart people from different backgrounds You are a voracious learner & an eager teacher of others You don't tolerate intra-office posturing or other douchebaggery How To Apply If this sounds like the start you're looking for, we'd like to hear from you. Apply directly through our careers site. SPAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to discuss reasonable accommodations during the hiring process.
